comment: The LibVLC the application ships: the trees libvlc-nogpl.yml built without GPL code,
promoted by libvlc-publish.yml to a prerelease of this repository and pinned here by the SHA-512
of each asset as published. The build is not reproducible byte for byte, so the hash of what was
verified is the only thing that can name it. fetch-libvlc.ps1 refuses any other bytes, and the
MSBuild import in eng/libvlc/LibVlc.targets calls it before the tree is copied anywhere.
sourceAsset is the corresponding source of exactly these trees: VLC at the tag, the patches and
scripts at the commit that built them, and every contrib tarball the build fetched.
